notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today marks exactly one year since the release of the Hero's Story action game. During this year, the game has received two major updates, as well as several hotfixes. New game mechanics, as well as new locations and items were added. Many new players set foot on the lands of Teandria for the first time, and I would like to thank everyone again for their support of the game and your feedback! To celebrate this significant date, I decided to release another fairly large anniversary update - it fixes some long-standing bugs, adds new settings and slightly improves performance. I hope you will enjoy this anniversary update!



You can find full list of changes below.


General
 

Hidden "What's New" block in Main Menu
Additions
 

Added "Display Mode" option instead of "Fullscreen Mode" in the Options Menu

Added sound when trying to switch weapons when the player has not picked up a weapon

Added a separate effect for the Cleric's Greater Heal 
Balance
 

Slightly increased the chance of poisoning a character from mushrooms

Anti-Magic Potion duration decreased from 600 to 300 seconds

The amount of energy restored by Watermelon increased from 20 to 25

The amount of stamina restored by Swamp Mushroom increased from 5 to 10

The amount of health restored by Potato decreased from 40 to 35

The amount of energy restored by Magic Mushroom increased from 5 to 10

The amount of health restored by Apple increased from 10 to 20

The amount of health restored by Fish increased from 15 to 20

The cost of Old Goblet decreased from 100 to 50 coins

Now Rotten Flesh will restore a little health (but can poison the character)

The Ghoul's Eye will also restore a little health (but can poison character)

True Fire will now restore a little energy (but can set the character on fire)

Ectoplasm will also restore a little energy (but can scare the character)

Queen's Posion can no longer be used (like other quest items)

All quest items will now cost 1 gold

All quest items can no longer be dropped
Optimization
 

Removed redundant calls to various methods and functions from the program code

Disabled unsupported lighting mode on game levels 
Bugfixes
 

Fixed a bug where consumables would not heal the player completely when their health was increased

Fixed a bug where the character's health would be restored after reaching 0

Fixed a graphical bug where the loading screen background did not take up all of the available area

Fixed a graphical bug where the fire effect in the Cultist's hands continued to burn after his death

Fixed a bug where the "I'm helpful, am I not?" achievement was not counted

Fixed a bug where changing mouse sensitivity or invert was not applied immediately

Fixed a bug where changing mouse invert was not saved when reloading a level

Fixed bugs with some items not being displayed correctly in the game logs

Minor fixes
Other
 

Removed game maps not used in the game

Removed music tracks not used in the game

Updated in-game credits



Have a good one! Silent.

notes.title: Happy Holidays
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

Today marks exactly six months since the release of Hero's Story from Steam Early Access. I would like to express my gratitude to the entire community of my games and inform you that in honor of the upcoming holidays, both of my games are on sale for a limited time. But that's not all.

CLASS CHANGE IN TRAINING

Did you know that you can change your character's class in training? To do this, start a new game for the desired class, save the game, go to the menu, delete the save, and then start the training. 
Note: do not delete the save if you have not made a backup or disabled cloud saves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/f8ac2078c3011aa97b2e30fb4738bdf36ba23adb.jpg

SAVE BACKUP

Did you know that you can make a backup of your save in Hero's Story? This will protect you from losing data and will help you restore your progress if you made the wrong decision. Game saves are located in the AppData\Local\MansLife\Saved\SaveGames folder. You can also disable cloud saves in Steam if you need to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/a503891428c47697b35be1a524433b2fc4bb1857.png

CHANGE CONTROLS

You can change some game settings without entering the game itself. Configuration files are located in the AppData\Local\MansLife\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor folder, but you should change them with caution! So, in the GameUserSettings.ini file you can change the graphic settings, and in Input.ini - change the control scheme.

notes.title: Second Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

Today a new update for Hero's Story was released.
It fixed the shortcomings of the previous version, added new artifact mechanics and a new location, and updated the game bosses. In this update I tried to listen to the opinions of the players, so the rewards for defeating monsters were increased and the cooldown of the hero's abilities was reduced. I also fixed the annoying hint for players that character can open the door. 
I hope you will like this update!

You can find full list of changes below.


General


 Now ability description will include the cooldowns

Additions

 New location: Smuggler's Path

Balance


 Slightly increased the distance from which the character can open doors

Now let's take a closer look at some points.

ARTIFACTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/d872f682432c288ed730bc290ae73c2b2cab91d8.gif

Artifacts are the ultimate goal of wanderers' searches. These are powerful items that temporarily grant a certain power - for example, the ability to not spend an arrow when shooting, get additional glory points or reduce the cooldown of abilities. Artifacts can only be found in closed iron chests!

BOSSES UPDATE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/1dd20cace0576e25b17dbadabd087a5630bea9d0.gif

Boss battles in the new version will become more interesting and difficult! Each boss will have a new type of attack - for example, Spider Queen will learn to attack from a distance, High Necromancer will be protected by a dark shield and the Fallen Knight will be able to carry out a deadly ultimate attack. Good luck in battle!

SMUGGLER'S PATH

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/079138ca2921e95fcf597fc46913259f6422be23.png

Somewhere in the mountains in the north there is an abandoned passage, which, according to rumors, can be opened with a special seal. They say that this passage has long been used by smugglers and slave traders, and that this path leads to the Trade Coast. Who knows - perhaps you will yet have to go to unknown lands in search of new adventures...

As always, you can leave your impressions of the update in the comments or discussions.

Enjoy the game! Your Silent.

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

Today, Hero's Story received its first major update since its release.
This update added a new dungeon to the game - the Ruins of Shasaf, added a mechanic for fast travel through the Obelisks, and fixed a large number of various bugs.
Please note that Shasaf will only open after completing the game, and to move through the obelisks, you will first need to find a valuable item.
I hope you enjoy this update!

You can find full list of changes below.


General


 Now when trying to move to the Swamp of Myths, a corresponding warning will be displayed
 Changed the description of the 'Learning Stones' achievement
 Changed (corrected) the description of the Fire Protection Potion

Additions


 New location: Ruins of Shasaf
 New mechanics: Fast Travel
 Added new items to some merchants
 Added additional save points in the Swamp of Myths
 Added sound when putting on an amulet
 Updated the icon of the executable file

Balance


 Slightly increased the chance of Antidote dropping from shamans
 Slightly increased the chance of Quiver dropping from skeleton archers
 Adjusted the height of the poisonous area in the Swamp of Myths
 Reduced the amount of glory points given for completing some actions

Optimization


 Limited the area of ​​​​lighting calculation on some levels
 Removed temporary files from the project folder
 Removed unused fragments of program code

Bugfixes


 Fixed a bug when quests in the list on the left were incorrectly marked as completed
 Fixed a bug when chests would sometimes be empty after loading the game
 Fixed a bug when the hover tooltip for some glory ranks was displayed incorrectly
 Fixed a bug when the hover tooltip for some merchant goods was displayed incorrectly
 Fixed a bug when some NPCs and quest items would remain in place after completing the corresponding quests
 Fixed a bug when the main quest would not update correctly in some cases
 Fixed a bug preventing one of the Steam achievements from being obtained
 Fixed a bug with the critical hit chance display in the character screen
 Minor level fixes

Other


 Changed the game build settings so that game updates take up less space and load faster


Now let's take a closer look at some points.

RUINS OF SHASAF

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/c0862dbd7519dd9f621e8a34649b0045878ea3f3.png

The ruins of the once proud wanderer city of Shasaf are located in the east of the Endless Desert.
Magical storms and fortress walls reliably protect the peace of the city's inhabitants from careless travelers and desert spirits.
They say that the passage to them will open only when a great evil is defeated.
They also say that the city has long been empty and has become a haven for spirits...

MYSTERY OF THE OBELISK

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/e29758d10787d1dc2c5845a686a36b0a93464db6.png

The obelisks scattered throughout Teandria have long attracted the attention of various researchers!
Such mages as Algus and Angelica have long tried to compare ancient records, and came to the conclusion that the monuments can be used as a kind of portals.
However, to activate them, you will need a fragment of an ancient crystal hidden deep in the ancient Angalar catacombs...
Players will be able to quickly move between already found obelisks after activating the crystal.

BUGFIXES & IMPROVEMENTS

After the release of any game, there are still things that require attention.
Although most of the critical bugs were fixed immediately after the release with the help of small updates, nevertheless, there are still bugs in the game.
In this update, problems with game levels, the ability to increase the chance of a critical hit and some other errors were fixed.
In future updates, I will continue to fix and improve the game - but after my trip for treatment.

As always, you can leave your impressions of the update in the comments or discussions.

Enjoy the game! Your Silent.

In the release version, players have access to the tutorial, a new region - the Swamp of Myths, and the opportunity to defeat the final boss and complete the game!
Also, new achievements, enemies, items were added, and a large number of various bugs were fixed.
Controller support was improved and localization was supplemented. Class balance and loot from monsters were also adjusted.
Note that this is not the last version of the game, and after the launch, various fixes and updates will be released for Hero's Story.
Thanks to everyone who supported the development of the game during Early Access!

Quests

Bugfixes

Let's take a closer look at some points.

DESTROYER OF WORLDS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/7cc296f75cbc93c8a765965616470943b9a24980.jpg

A man named Algus began his journey as a wizard in the academies of Angalar, where he studied the art of magic. Over time, his heart began to gravitate towards forbidden and dark knowledge.
With charisma and the ability to convince people of his rightness, Algus began to gather acolytes around him, ready to follow him into the darkness. One day, Algus stole an ancient artifact with colossal magical power and disappeared without a trace for many years. It was believed that he died.
Now, Algus's tracks have led wanderers to a mysterious swamp in the north, where the sinister wizard seems to have opened his new abode...
In a place where nature and magic intertwine, he again began to sow discord and fear, returning to take over the kingdom - or destroy it!

TUTORIAL

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/b00ec3d51e5279dfa210f46380f36d36138605bd.jpg

You will undergo training in the Arsenal, where you will learn movement, exploration and the basics of combat. Our best instructors will lead you through a series of simple tests, after which you will be able to confidently enter the lands of Teandria.
Hero's Story players have long been asking for a tutorial system, and in the full version this request has finally been fulfilled. All new players in Hero's Story will be offered to complete the tutorial (or if you delete your save). Good luck in the game!

SWAMP OF MYTHS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/eae8aea202722f0a7cbafe64fb019e521db8c128.jpg

In the north of the kingdom of Teandria there is a poisonous magical swamp, in which ancient evil lurks. This ominous place is covered in misty darkness and filled with twisted magic, permeated with toxic fumes! The wild inhabitants of this inhospitable place handle powerful spells, which fills the hearts of even the bravest adventurers with anxiety.
Among the ominous branches and spreading bushes rises the formidable temple of Hamuraptra - an ancient sanctuary, where ancient spells still sound like an eternal echo.
Whoever dares to cross the swamp and enter the ancient temple will open the doors to old magic and secrets, but will also sacrifice his soul on the altar of everlasting evil...

notes.title: Great Dragon Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes.

Today a major update was released for Hero's Story.
This update added a new region - Isil Plateau, as well as the new items and enemies, new locations and sounds, lockpicking mechanics and a new boss - the Great Dragon!
This is a big update that fixes many bugs and significantly changes the balance of the combat system. This will most likely be the last update before the full game is released.
Let me remind you that the full version of Hero's Story will have a complete storyline, tutorial and a final boss.

You can find the full list of changes below!


General


 Game version was updated to 1.1 RC2
 Now when you hover over an item in your inventory, its price will be shown
 Now the price of all items will be at least 1 gold
 Now you can also attack enemies using RMB
 Players will now have some chance of dealing critical damage
 Changed the 'Warehouse' level music theme
 Updated control scheme for the keyboard
 Updated game credits scene
 'Credits' section in main menu has become active again

Additions


 New region: Isil Plateau
 New boss: Great Dragon Krde
 New game mechanics: Lockpicking
 New game mechanics: Chaos Portals
 New location: Abandoned House
 New location: Throne Room
 New location: Troll's Cave
 New enemy type: Mountain Troll
 New enemy type: Griffin
 Added new NPCs
 Added new items and sounds
 Added new pop-up notifications
 Added new hidden Steam achievement
 Added the ability to return to the Duke's Keep
 Added portals to the Endless Desert (for faster travel)
 Added passage to the Sacred Grove from the Magic Forest and back
 An auto-run key has also been added to the controller (Back/left stick)
 Added new testing level
 Added more materials for the full version of the game

Balance


 Now all enemies will drop at least something upon their defeat
 Increased the amount of health restored by Healing Potion from 50 to 60
 Increased the amount of energy restored by Energy Potion from 50 to 60
 Reduced damage dealt by Mysterious Sphere to rakshasas
 The shooting mechanics of Skeleton Archers have been changed (it has become more accurate)
 Outlaws will now be able to apply bleed, but Zombies will not
 Increased Zombie health
 Now the Zombie will have a small chance of poisoning the player
 Changed the attack animation of the Sea Giants
 Increased damage of the Sea Giants
 Reduced the attack speed of the Sea Giants
 Skeleton Warriors and Rakshasa Warriors will now be able to block some of the melee attacks
 Increased damage of Rakshasa Warriors
 Reduced attack speed of Rakshasa Warriors
 Now Sorceresses and Rakshasas will be able to teleport during fight
 Sorceress and Rakshasa attack speed has been slightly reduced
 High Necromancer's health was significantly increased
 Spider Queen health was significantly increased

Optimization


 Removed unused game levels
 Removed some unused code fragments

Bugfixes


 Fixed a critical bug when game settings were not saved correctly
 Fixed a graphical bug when particles from being hit by the Mysterious Orb would be replayed
 Fixed a bug when the sounds of eating and drinking were not always played
 Fixed a bug when it was impossible to change the game language from the pause menu
 Fixed a bug when location names did not appear after cutscenes
 Fixed a bug when the sounds of hitting the Spider Queen were too loud
 Fixed a bug when it was possible to get out of bounds in the Magic Forest
 Fixed incorrect placement of some landscape elements in the Expanse
 Minor fixes to buildings in the Expanse
 Minor changes to game levels
 Minor fixes


Let's take a closer look at some points.

GREAT DRAGON

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/c3f12b002d5864b76152693f44c6460eb5569853.gif

It was always possible to get through the Isil Gorge into the Swamp of Myths via a single bridge, built during the Old Era.
Rumor has it that a huge dragon recently settled on this bridge! This winged monster has killed many knights and now terrorizes the lands of Central Teandria.
The king will generously reward anyone who can crush or drive away the powerful creature. In the battle with the dragon, potions of protection from fire and magic will help you.

NEW REGION

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/393168fee1dc37d94a93c9a686fef84481c1753f.gif

The mountain range north of Enthor divides the lands of Central Teandria into a few separate regions.
One of these areas is the Isil Plateau, which will be available to players in this update!
The new region consists of several zones and includes several new locations, including an abandoned hut on a hill and a troll cave on a cliff.
Only the most experienced adventurers will be able to defeat all the enemies in this area and collect all of the treasures.

LOCKPICKING

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/b14d363dfd1e1ef2bb4869a0c5699f7c5ed80b2d.png

During your adventures in the lands of Central Teandria, you probably came across locked chests.
Now you can try to open these chests using a new item - lockpick.
The more valuable the contents of the chest, the more difficult it is to unlock it! Lockpicks can be obtained from chests or found in different caches.

I also remind you that a small demo version of the game is available on Steam store page.

Enjoy the game, and see you in the full version! Your Silent.

notes.title: Fallen Knight Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes! 

Today Hero's Story is one step closer to release.
New update adds a third boss, in-game cutscenes and localization system.
Also, the size of the game installation files has been reduced by almost half - and nothing has been cut from the game! This is an important update that fixes many significant bugs, removes some restrictions and generally makes life better for players!

As always you will find the full list of changes below. I hope that you will enjoy this update :)


General


 Game version was updated to 1.1 RC1
 Main Menu was updated
 The game will now slow down by 90 percent when opening service windows (for example, inventory)
 Now players will be able to accumulate a total of more than 10,000 gold coins
 Players will now be able to accumulate over 5,000 Glory Points
 Ghosts will now drop Ectoplasm
 Ghouls will now drop Ghoul's Eye
 The 'Ally' section of the character screen has been changed to 'Origin'

 Changed (updated) names of some monsters
 Aligned all location names in the UI
 Tooltips on loading screens and in the game itself have also been aligned
 Updated icon for the Queen's Poison

Additions


 New boss: Fallen Knight Kriege
 New location: Knight's Dungeon
 New game mechanics: Cutscenes
 Localization system was implemented in main menu
 Added splash screen for full version
 New loading screens were added to the game
 Added new Glory Points ranks
 Added new items and sounds
 New items also appeared at merchants
 Added 1 hidden Steam achievement
 Added Ragdoll physics for some enemies and weapons
 Added Auto Run hotkey (= key)
 Added ability to change character's FOV
 Added materials for the full version of the game

Balance


 Defense bonuses for Glory Points ranks have been removed

Optimization


 Removed some unused pieces of AI code
 Optimized settings for some pickup items
 Optimized game character animation settings

 Optimized number of game levels in the game build

Other


 Changed death animations for skeletons and skeleton archers

 Pumpkin Skeleton was removed from the game

Bugfixes


 Fixed a critical bug where it was possible to re-find treasures after reloading the level
 Fixed a critical bug where defeated enemies would revive after reloading the level
 Fixed a bug where many sounds were playing too loud in some cases
 Fixed a bug where some tooltips were appearing too often
 Fixed a bug with portals not working in Temple of Dragons
 Fixed a bug where it was impossible to close the inventory from controller
 Fixed a bug where menu displayed incorrect control settings for the gamepad
 Fixed a bug where some pop-up notifications were not fully visible on the screen
 Fixed a bug where healing potions were not saved correctly due to an incorrect (similar) name
 Fixed a bug where tooltips for pickup items would not appear on hover (they would only appear once)
 Fixed an issue where new weapons were not properly damaging spiders and sand spiders
 Lots of small fixes


And now let's take a closer look at some points.

OLD KNIGHT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/9b807fbd0e2977e35b4f647c9e18a13f27cf210e.png

The Kriege family crypt had once seen better days. Now this place is guarded only by king’s revived soldiers, restless servants and revived renegade magicians.
They say that the old knight himself still wanders in dungeons of the family crypt in Expanse! Who can get into the dungeon and put ghost of the past to rest forever?

LOCALIZATION SYSTEM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/2bcffafe4de8f4db75a83704408dc11e24e54c13.gif

In the new version game now will have a localization system. This means that players will now be able to change the language in game settings in the main menu.
Localization affects in-game texts, interface and various materials. There are only two options available for now, but more languages may be supported in the future.
The game itself will also try to determine most suitable language when you first launch the updated version.

IN-GAME CUTSCENES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/98a7821e24957d209ac10ddc13d18e7f1a6025c7.gif

In-game cutscenes play important role in any modern game. They designed to, for example, indicate the path, introduce a new enemy or a boss and also simply make the story more entertaining!
It is worth noting that in the full version of Hero's Story there will be more in-game cutscenes. All in-game cutscenes are made using game engine.

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Your Silent.

notes.title: Beta Update #23
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes! 

Today a new Early Access update for Hero's Story has been officially released.
This massive update brought new weapons to each of the four character classes,
the ability to buy and sell various items to traveling merchants, and also added a new location
in the Magic Forest - a Giant Cave.
This update is interesting not only because it brought some variety to the gameplay, but also because
gold coins finally have a good use (besides the associated achievement, of course).
The new location differs from those already added to the game in that it includes some acrobatic elements.

I hope you'll like this update! You will find a list of changes below.


General


 The Pumpkin Collector event is now active again
 The game will now again pause when opening the inventory  
 Debug messages have been disabled at all levels of the game

Additions


 New location: Giant Cave
 New mechanics: Merchants
 Added new weapons for each class
 Added additional notifications for some weapons and save/load

Balance


 Reduced the requirement for Glory Points to enter The Catacombs
 Reduced 'friendly fire' damage for enemies
 Slightly increased the speed of player's arrows
 Slightly increased the distance from which enemy healthbars are visible
 Slightly increased the range of 'Flash of Light' ability.
 The mechanic of Ghosts and Ghosts of Shasaf where they ignored physical damage completely has been replaced with a 50% chance to miss hit on them

Optimization


 Removed unused movies from the game folder
 Removed some unused code fragments

Other


 Changes have begun to be made to the game for the full version
 The mechanics of interaction/items picking up have been slightly changed
 Changed the mechanics of displaying enemy health bars (they are updated more often now)

Bugfixes


 Fixed a critical bug with duplicate tasks in the Quest List and Journal in some cases
 Fixed a critical bug when the character class was reset to Warrior after loading the game
 Fixed a bug when the player's arrows would sometimes deal damage multiple times in a row
 Fixed a bug when NPCs without available quests would not leave the map as intended
 Fixed a bug when the notification about the Fear effect applied to a character was not displayed
 Fixed a bug when 'Divine Armor' ability would also deal some magic damage
 Fixed a bug when 'Haste' ability would also deal some magic damage
 Fixed a bug when 'Flash of Light' ability would deal more damage than expected
 Fixed a bug  when enemies would not pursue the Cleric after using the 'Flash of Light' ability.
 Fixed a bug  when ability cooldowns would sometimes not reset after loading the game
 Minor fixes


And now let's take a closer look at some points...

GIANT CAVE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/034b3af13697517ea493ef54d89b6103ebbed1a0.gif

Closer to the western border of the Magic Forest, if you walk along the river bank, you can stumble upon the entrance to a huge cave.
According to royal researchers, this is one of the largest natural caves in the kingdom!
Surely there is something interesting in it. While exploring the cave, try not to fall from a height, because your hero is not immortal yet.

TRAVELING MERCHANTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/81dc92f37f8ca1d1f8a567e799665ec41c50a4fe.gif

During their adventures heroes accumulate enough gold to, for example, replenish their stock of potions, purchase new equipment or simply get rid of unnecessary things.
The new update will bring traders to the world of Teandria who will be able to both buy things you no longer need and sell various useful items.
One of them, goblin Harrosh, is located in the Expanse region not far from a cave with poisonous spiders (yes, goblins are not the best marketers). Prepare your gold, heroes!

NEW WEAPONS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/200b0b9cba680ae1f5461ee18f0c266b9e3be10e.gif

Even in early versions of the game I wanted the heroes to have different starting weapons. Finally, the time has come to make this wish come true.
Starting with this version, each class will start the game with its own set of equipment! The warriors' weapons will remain the same. The rogues will learn to throw knives and acquire two deadly daggers.
The mage class wields a staff and a mysterious sphere. The cleric is armed with a club, a magic tome and a heavy crossbow. The battles will become even more glorious!

This is final update of Hero's Story Beta.

Have fun! Your Silent.

notes.title: Beta Update #22
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

Another fairly large update for the beta version of Hero's Story has been released today.
This update added new abilities for each class, brought back ladder movement mechanic and added an entrance to one of the largest planned dungeons in the game - The Catacombs!
A long-standing inventory bug was also fixed, where player items would either disappear or be duplicated after loading.
A nice bonus is the graphical changes to some levels, effect of fall damage and user interface fixes.
You can find the full list of changes below.


General


 Now when selecting a class (and on the character screen) players will see available abilities
 Now on the character screen (C) you can see exact number of Glory Points
 Now values of the number of destroyed objects, luck, killed monsters and available arrows will be correctly saved in the game's memory

Additions


 New Location: Catacombs
 New mechanics: Ladders
 Added new abilities for each class
 Added fall damage effect
 Added new types of pop-up notifications on the right
 Added some materials for future updates

Balance


 Warrior: Added the Fury (F) ability to buff the Warrior's next two hits and restore some health
 Warrior: Added the "Heavenly Armor" (H) ability which greatly increases the warrior's defense for a while (both magical and physical)
 Mage: Added some AoE Damage from Fireball (F)
 Mage: Increased cooldown of Fireball (F) from 10 to 20 seconds
 Mage: Increased the cooldown of Lesser Heal (H) from 5 to 10 seconds
 Rogue: Added the ability "Fury" (F) which greatly increases the attack speed of the rogue for a short period of time
 Rogue: Added the Haste (H) ability to briefly increase rogue's movement speed
 Cleric: Added the ability "Flash of Light" (F) which casts light magic around the cleric
 Cleric: Added the Greater Heal (H) ability which restores the majority of the cleric's health

Optimization


 Removed some unused code snippets
 Pointwise optimized game's code

Bugfixes


 Fixed a critical bug when some items were missing in the player's inventory
 Fixed a bug when in the location 'Magic Forest' the character's speed did not increase, as in other open locations
 Mage: Fixed a bug where Lesser Heal (H) was using twice as much energy as intended
 Abandoned Keep Graphic Fixes
 Duke's Keep Graphic Fixes
 Minor changes to the main menu (New Game especially)
 Minor changes to service windows (Map, Character etc.)
 Other fixes


And now let's take a closer look at some points!

CATACOMBS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/80a3b8a3c34d416b3e3d66e7e22c440e36cf29ec.jpg

Network of underground tunnels stretches far beyond the Magic Forest. The Catacombs were originally built to mine valuable rocks and honor the dead, but soon became a haven for evil spirits and other undead. Only the most experienced heroes will be able to get into the Catacombs!

NEW ABILITIES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/d2709f59e8c35c02a5721c39abe05c9013631fe6.gif

From now on, each class will have its own unique abilities. Warriors will be able to hit harder and increase protection, rogues will be able to run and attack faster and clerics will be able to hit with light magic. LADDERS

notes.title: Beta Update #21
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

In the new Hero's Story update not only a new location and a new type of enemies were added, but also improvements and fixed some problems related to balance and sound.
So, for archery or crossbow shooting the appropriate projectiles are now required - you can find them lying on the levels, in Old Chests or as a reward for defeating Skeleton Archers! The opponents themselves will now pursue the player longer and better bypass the obstacles that arise in their path. Patrol mechanics was added.
The loot balance from chests has also been revised and missing monster sounds have been added. Fixed an issue where many 3D sounds were played incorrectly in the distance.
The new location is one of the most difficult, but also the most interesting to beat, in my opinion. The in-game HUD has been slightly improved. The only thing that has been given less attention in this update is the fixing of various bugs.

I hope you will like this update!

Full list of changes can be found below.

General


 Updated the appearance of the Ghosts of Shasaf
 UI: Changed the appearance of the boss health bar
 UI: Added a projectile counter in the lower right corner

Additions


 New Location: Abandoned Fortress
 New mechanics: Patrols
 New enemy type: Ghosts
 New items
 New books and sounds

Balance


 Now all enemies will react to taking damage from a distance
 Now enemies will learn to bypass dynamic obstacles
 Increased the time interval during which monsters will chase the player's character
 Increased the distance from which enemies' health is visible
 Now the appropriate projectiles will be required for archery or crossbow shooting
 Reduced the probability with which Ghouls could impose a Fear effect on the player's character
 Now small healing and energy potions will no longer fall out of the Chaos Chest
 The Underwater Breath Potion will no longer be found in the Chaos Chest
 More gold coins can now be found in Gold Chests
 Now it will be impossible to find medium energy and healing potions in Old Chests

Optimization


 Removed extra navigation mesh in Temple of Dragons
 Some additional settings of game objects were disabled

Bugfixes


 Fixed a bug where Ghouls could impose Fear on a hero under the influence of anti-magic
 Fixed a bug where the Spider Queen got stuck in columns during a battle with her
 Fixed a bug where monster surround sounds were played as normal
 Various game level fixes
 Other fixes


And now let's take a closer look at some points!

ABANDONED KEEP

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/cdc5fc0659b6d6da77cce0abb22e51da727f23b3.png

The fortress of Al' Nazir stands on the outskirts of the Magic Forest. Long abandoned, it serves as both a reminder of power of the ancient kingdom and danger of using magic to harm.
Rumor has it that there are many treasures and rare things hidden inside! However, now just getting into the fortress itself is not an easy task.

NEW ENEMIES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/08e7150f2711a17058c22f54d743c8bde930f3ba.gif

Ghosts of Al' Nazir warriors are dangerous opponents. They cannot be hit with normal weapons, and when touched, they can slow down an unprepared hero.
Being one of the most dangerous and little-studied of the undead, ghosts can impose horror into even most experienced warriors.

AI IMPROVEMENTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/8db8f051967d87951947677e53f246fd48a46392.png

In the new update, opponents have learned how to bypass obstacles that appear on their way, move along predetermined routes, and also respond to
any hit on them. In future updates, it is planned to continue work on improving and balancing the AI.

Have fun! Your Silent.

MAGIC FOREST

The first update of 2023 brings to Hero's Story new location, glory points system and updated books. This is a very important update - after all, both the glory points system and the books are important parts of the game! Of course, the glory points will still be balanced in the future and the bonuses from the glory ranks in full version will definitely be different, but now at least you can try this system "on the tooth" and share your opinion in discussions, by email or on social media. In this update I have managed to fix some annoying bugs, a couple of annoying ones for players particularly. I hope you will enjoy this update!

Now let's take a closer look at some points.

WATCHTOWER

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/22b0872c3d329fb2079e821b6997e09c33d02504.png

To the southeast of the Duke's Keep stands an ancient Watchtower. It was built during the wars with the barbarians. Later, the cruel duke remade the structure to suit his dark needs, but after Enthor relationship with Solheim went through another crisis, the guards again use it for its intended purpose. And what a view it offers!

GLORY POINTS SYSTEM

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/1e31d48aad732dcf4bea9b1c2f914b3e6eb5390e.png

Having accumulated enough glory points, the player's character moves to the next 'rank' and receives a certain bonus. In the current version, bonuses and the number of ranks themselves are very limited, but you can try to declare yourself as a mighty hero right now!

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Today exactly three years ago Hero's Story Early Access was released on Steam. During this time 37 updates were released, in which many game mechanics, levels, enemies and various items were added.
The game settings have been completely redesigned, inventory and a save system have been added, a lot of bugs have been fixed, weather effects have been added. New Steam achievements, bosses and destructible objects have been added.
I would like to thank all the players who have supported me all these years, left their feedback, share screenshots and just explored the vast world of Teandria!
Of course, I don't plan to stop there, and today I present to you anniversary update of Hero's Story Early Access.
In it I fixed some critical bugs, added fall damage and hints at the beginning of the game, and also introduced a new character class - Cleric!

Let's take a closer look at some points.

NEW CLASS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/809b38fbda638f8e178fab195f6ba6777a73ddaa.png

Clerics of the Order of Light have long been famous for their wisdom and mercy. These formidable adepts of light do not have obvious advantages, but also do not have strong disadvantages, which makes them universal warriors. Clerics also use healing spells more effectively.

FALL DAMAGE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/bfe09d8ae582c5d6f85c3c0c11b6917273a48ef2.gif

Fall damage is another mechanic from earlier versions of the game, as well as one of the main mechanics in any modern game. Depending on how fast your character was moving, he will receive different amount of damage. At the moment, you can't die from falling in the game.

PUMPKIN COLLECTOR RETURNS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/59a299b30f3e3f6e9d7d57f720da0a591a906db6.png

The annual event returns on the eve of the Halloween holiday. This time there will be no Pumpkin Skeletons waiting for you around the corner, but there will be a few more Pumpkins in the game world. Let me remind you that collecting pumpkins is not only pleasant, but also useful - after all, 10 of them are needed to get the achievement of the same name. And what kind of soup is obtained from them!

The full list of changes can be found below.

General


 'Pumpkin Collector' event returns!
 Now bosses will be invincible before the start of the fight
 Now all of the enemies will react to arrow or fireball hit

Additions

Optimization

 Minor fixes

Have fun! Your Silent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/f14675a49e63ea18013e29a2b4a095ca1481b758.png

Now, finally, the treasure chests are returning - with improved mechanics and visual. The contents of the chests are selected randomly, and the treasures inside have a certain drop chance. For example, you will more often come across empty chests or chests with one coin than chests with a handful of gold coins or keys. Endless Desert

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32275937/34dec66a21a7806d852d36cad4f40ec3c75ca041.png

The Endless Desert is the second of the planned zones in the Hero's Story game. It is a desert with ruins, cacti, oases and ancient secrets. To get into this zone, you need to get out of the Duke's Prison and move along the road towards the mine. New locations in this zone will be opened gradually with the release of updates, as was the case with Expanse. Rakshasas are restless desert spirits who pose a serious threat to our hero. They notice our hero much better than skeletons and have better combat characteristics. Rakshasa warriors, among other things, have an increased health reserve due to a thicker chitinous shell. I recommend fighting them with full stamina, luring them out one at a time! Hello, heroes!

Yesterday pretty big update for Hero's Story was released, which updated game levels, disabled temporary abilities and spells, as well as corrected sounds, lighting, interface, and much more. Let's look through each item in more detail!

General

The game has been updated to the beta version. This means that the mechanics and solutions added to the game now are likely to remain in the release version. The game version itself remains the same (1.0.6), as many changes were not included in the first beta update.

Interface

Main menu scene has been updated. Some of the labels used for debugging the game were removed too. I also plan to update Settings menu in the upcoming updates.

Character creation

The choice of faction 'allegiance' was replaced with the choice of character's 'origins'. For now, this is more of a cosmetic change, but in the future, the faction selection will be updated to the character's starting class selection. Choosing a random faction was removed from the game, because it was not popular and did not make much sense in terms of lore.

Game levels

The first levels of the game have been completely reworked. On the other levels, the lighting was changed.

Physics

Some game objects had their physics disabled to make the game more stable. At this stage, there is no clear separation between which objects are dynamic and which are not, and this is what I plan to fix in future updates.

Sound and music

Some sounds have been replaced or removed from the game. For example, many players were annoyed by the loud sound of the character's armor - it was made quieter. notes.title: Early Access Pros & Cons
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes!

There are a lot of articles written on the Internet about “Pros and Cons of Steam Early Access” both for the game itself and for the players. Today I would like to share with you my thoughts about the upcoming Early Access of Hero's Story and how this may affect the game.

Firstly, I am sure that in my case Early Access is rather good than bad. Some players are waiting for the game from 2013, and after a series of transfers, failures and frost, it is better to release the project at least in some state than not releasing at all - otherwise Hero's Story risks joining the “cool games that the world never saw”.

Secondly, Early Access will help get feedback from you, dear players, and make the game better. For example, now I think that there are more than enough dungeons, and they are well balanced, but in fact, maybe there are not enough treasures, or the enemies are too strong. There are questions about the design - is it convenient to control the game, does it run correctly on different machines, and which FPS it produces.

Thirdly, in my case (I remind you that I work alone) this is a good way to successfully continue and complete the project from a financial point of view - because I still do not plan campaigns on Kickstarter or similar sites for my projects. Having released the backbone of the game in Early Access, I plan to add new game zones, enemies, quests, and perhaps even game mechanics.

Finally, Early Access can be bad because the game will come out raw and scare away the audience. In the bottom line we have:

Pluses:
+ The price of the game in the Early Access will be less
+ Players will be able to play the game earlier
+ Ability to influence the development process
+ Free updates

Minuses:
- The game may be less stable
- The amount of content in the first versions can be much less

These are my thoughts. What do you think? Let me remind you that Hero's Story Early Access is scheduled for September of this year.

Stay strong! Your faithfully, Silentplaygames.
